csv_dialect: comma, doublequote, QUOTE_MINIMAL; header included; final LF
row_order: dataset, compound, endpoint, configuration, time lexical; concentration Decimal numeric; concentration_unit lexical
numeric_policy: Exact source CSV strings retained; no rounding, rescaling, response interpolation or resampling.
row_key_set_hash_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical CSV with KEY header and all unique key rows in the same numeric-dose row order; includes final LF
reveal_condition: Custodian receives prediction_manifest.json, verifies protocol/input/model/selection/calibration/predictions/choices hashes and complete query coverage, then explicitly releases identical committed bytes through the same task entrypoint.
isolation: Procedural entrypoint isolation on shared filesystem. sealed permissions 0700/0600; same-user agents are not cryptographically isolated. Existing parent source package stays unchanged.
